on_screen_text.text: Hillary Clinton on Roe v. Wade

spoken_summary: Hillary Clinton describes the Supreme Court opinion overturning Roe v. Wade as "dark" and "incredibly dangerous." She argues that the decision is about much more than a woman's right to choose and that everyone's rights are at stake. Clinton warns that people who think the issue doesn't affect them because they aren't a woman, Black, or gay are mistaken, stating, "once you allow this kind of extreme power to take hold, you have no idea who they will come for next." She concludes that the "only answer is at the ballot box" to elect people who will protect Americans' rights.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of clear dialogue from an interview, with no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is edited in a simple talking-head style, featuring a static close-up on the speaker with one brief cutaway to a reaction shot of the interviewer.
central_claim: The overturning of Roe v. Wade is a dangerous expansion of power that threatens all Americans, and the only solution is to vote for candidates who will protect individual rights.
intended_effect: To alarm viewers about the broad consequences of the Supreme Court's decision and motivate them to vote for candidates who support abortion rights and other civil liberties.
